title: Scope of the guard that stops replayed stage markers re-opening a closed change
context: Issue #540 root cause (verified): parseAndRecordMarkers re-parses the WHOLE transcript on every Stop. After closeActiveFeature the session control has active:null, so currentFeature() returns null, the per-bundle 'seen' set is empty, and every stale 'paqad:stage ...' marker in the transcript looks unrecorded. recordMarkedStage then auto-opens a fresh untitled change-<ULID> bundle. A background <task-notification> (Monitor/CI event) is what produced the extra Stop. Position/novelty is the only thing separating a legitimate first-marker open from a replay, so the guard needs a scope. Options differ in blast radius.

options.label: Suppress only when THIS session already closed a change
Suppress when the current branch has a closed change and nothing in flight
The retrospective marker seam never opens a bundle at all

rationale: Matches both phantoms observed on disk (same session closed 538 then minted change-01M25SX and change-01M268WT); narrowest blast radius, no change to a session's first change or to cross-provider first-change minting. Session-id rotation after a close is documented as a known limit rather than over-built.
